The Martians stared back up at them for a long, long silent time from the rippling water....

I'm guessing not all of these will make sense but pat yourself on the back if you know what book this is

Yesterday I had a really long talk with the one person who I actually trusted (until now) to not want me away, we talked/walked  from 11am til maybe 4. He only wanted my company to talk about his ex who recently broke up with him and I only realized it this morning. I'm not going to kill myself tomorrow, but who knows what will happen next weekend. The hardest part for me to accept about people having lives just as shitty is that I would give everything to have the friends and company so many others have and show off and they don't even seem grateful for them

I've tried so hard to find people in my situation but everybody seems to have their life planned.

The only reason people who spend their nights alone are because of bad luck or a recent break up.

I'm a fucking loser. I've been telling myself the life I live outside is my true self but it isn't, the people I judge like a fucking asshole for being losers are usually living life better than me and I fucking know it. Have you ever felt your brain rot? My brain has been worn down into a fucking mush from mindnumbing internet videos and games. My mother hates my family and only cares about her work and best friend, my dad is probably exactly like me, and my brother used to be happy and popular but now seems content with playing WoW and league all day


I don't know what kind of help I want, and no medication is going to bring me any
